text:
Elaine (sales): Quick sync — ACME wants a 2-week trial (they keep saying 'pilot') and they've asked for an architecture recommendation + success matrix. Need to decide deployment mode and region today.
Mike (solutions): Got it. Primary constraints?
Rahul (customer-eng): ACME is EU-only for data residency, SOC2 required, and legal asked about KMS/HSM. Timeline: kickoff Mon, 2 weeks to demo.
Elaine (sales): Yep EU residency and SOC2. They also want SLA-ish throughput for demo ~ 50 req/s peak.
Mike (solutions): For 50 rps, two options: hosted with EU region (fastest onboarding) or Dedicated (reserved GPUs) if they want predictable latency & isolation. Private/on-prem only if legal insists on air-gapped or private keys.
Ana (security): From SQ: must confirm where logs live, encryption at rest, and whether we can integrate their KMS. Hosted EU -> we can offer customer-managed KMS? We need to escalate for HSM.
Jo (product): For success matrix, recommend these KPIs: latency p95 < 250ms (inference), token cost per 1k, quality pass rate on eval prompts (>= 90% on NIST-style checks), and uptime >= 99.5% for the demo window.
Rahul (customer-eng): They also want an eval set: 120 prompts, mix of long context (~3k tokens) and short. Can we pre-warm cache for those?
Mike (solutions): Yes — can pre-cache prefixes and use small batch config. If Hosted, we can pre-warm within 24h. If Dedicated, we can pre-provision and pin model version.
Elaine (sales): Pricing question from procurement: what's rough delta between Hosted vs Dedicated for a 2-week pilot with ~100k tokens/day?
Mike (solutions): Rough ballpark: Hosted pay-as-you-go ~ $X per 1k gen tokens (estimate emailed). Dedicated: monthly minimum ~ $Yk/month plus lower per-token compute. For a 2-week pilot, hosted likely cheaper; Dedicated makes sense if they plan high sustained monthly volume. I'll DM procurement a quick estimate.
Ana (security): Action item: I need the completed security questionnaire fields: data residency, KMS, audit log retention, access control (SAML), ingress egress CIDR. Can someone get the customer's SQ doc?
Rahul (customer-eng): Uploading now -> link: https://acme.example/sq (shared).
Mike (solutions): I'll draft deployment recommendation: Hosted (EU) for trial, with canary to Dedicated if they commit; include fallback policies. Will attach config snippet.
Mike (solutions): ```
# deployment snippet
mode: hosted
region: eu-west-1
prewarm: true
model_pin: v1.3.0
batching: auto
```
Elaine (sales): Nice. Ana — is hosted EU acceptable given their SQ?
Ana (security): Acceptable if: 1) customer-managed KMS enabled, 2) logs exported to their SIEM, 3) SLA addendum for retention. If any of these fail -> Dedicated or Private.
Jo (product): For evals, I'll put together the prompt templates and quality rubric (precision/recall-ish checks and hallucination count). Suggest automated eval script to run nightly.
Elaine (sales): Next steps: Mike to send recommendation + cost delta by EOD, Ana to fill SQ answers, Jo to push eval prompts, Rahul to confirm region & share SQ doc. Demo plan: kickoff Mon, run trials Wed-Fri, show results next Tue.
deploy-bot: Dedicated cluster provisioning is optional — run `deploy check cluster` once provision approved.
Rahul (customer-eng): Confirmed I'll ask ACME to accept Hosted EU for trial and confirm KMS provider.
Elaine (sales): 👍 thanks team.
Mike (solutions): I'll post the estimate and config in this thread when done.
Ana (security): I'll annotate the SQ with required controls and flag anything that forces Private.
Jo (product): I'll seed the 120-prompt eval and share results dashboard link before demo.
Elaine (sales): Closing loop — if anyone sees blockers, call me.
